name: Amon Saito
source:
"We definitely have to have a match sometime!" 

Gyro-fighter Saito. Even today, he battles his rivals with the extremely popular toy "E Gyro". Parody on Yu-Gi-Oh main character.

Battle quote - "Here I go, Ishtar! We'll show you our power here!"
[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
